definition: Jubatus is an open-source online machine learning and distributed computing framework developed at Nippon Telegraph and Telephone and Preferred Infrastructure.
details: Its features include classification, recommendation, regression, anomaly detection and graph mining. It supports many client languages, including C++, Java, Ruby and Python. It uses Iterative Parameter Mixture for distributed machine learning.

explainer.lead: Jubatus is an open-source online machine learning and distributed computing framework developed at Nippon Telegraph and Telephone and Preferred Infrastructure. It supports classification, recommendation, regression, anomaly detection, and graph mining.

tiers.eli5: It is a toolkit for machine learning that keeps learning as new data arrives and shares the work across many machines.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it across many client languages, including C++, Java, Ruby and Python, with distributed learning via Iterative Parameter Mixture; the pitfall lies in coordinating that distributed training.
tiers.paperLevel: An open-source online machine learning and distributed computing framework using Iterative Parameter Mixture for distributed machine learning, with classification, recommendation, regression, anomaly detection and graph mining.

explainer.example: A service uses Jubatus to update a recommendation model as new user activity streams in, with work distributed across machines using Iterative Parameter Mixture.
